items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Loved him. Beautiful, wonderful. He's a Big professional im there, now Oh, yeah, Jimmy Blanton. He would have been with Duke.

ctx.x: Well, Milt Hinton, number one. And Oscar Pettiford. Of course, he was playing a bass like a violin player. But, I mean, he was just great execution-wise. And then you had -- oh, so many good bass players. But you still could put them on -- count them on your hands, on your fingers. Milt Hinton, oh, man.
What about Jimmy Blanton? What did you think of him?
